verdict: Leads are arriving; the gap is converting them into signed cases.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 18 leads from Meta at a cost of $158.95 per lead, a cost that dropped nearly 80% week-over-week as lead volume surged. Google Ads logged an additional 7 tracked conversions against $2,120.45 in spend, though no signed-case data is yet in place to confirm either channel's true close rate. The real gap right now is in intake: 74 opportunities entered the pipeline from 206 contacts this period, and zero converted to consultations or won cases — that is a pipeline flow issue, not an ads issue. We are working through your intake process this week to identify where inquiries are stalling before they reach a conversation. Next period, expect a clearer picture of which leads are progressing and tighter follow-up steps in place.
